text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Here at Tokyo Racecourse,
a public viewing 
of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is 
underway!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Look at this crowd! Every single one of 
them is praying for the victory of
Japan's 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...You poured everything into getting to 
this day. All to take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time to give it everything I 
have.
(UOOOOOOOOOH!)

Feverish excitement takes hold of the 
entire area. On this day, in this place, 
the world's strongest will be decided.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"First place goes to the American hero,
of 
course!" "It's the captivating beauty who 
enchanted Germany!" "Hmph... The British 
Queen shall reign supreme."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes.
A victory here will bring hope to 
our people."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: ‘That's why—’

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"‘...Ah!
That shadow is—’ ‘Here she comes! 
The prodigy of France!’"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Today—I will win. For the sake of... 
everyone in France!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "Glory shall be ours!"
(Wooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "Welcome, everyone! Welcome to France!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Please, enjoy yourselves! The beautiful 
scenery of ParisLongchamp. The lush 
greenery that brings color to your soul."

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"More than anything, bear witness to the 
running of the grand Umamusume blooming 
right here... Venus Park!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeek, Vénus Park--!!" "Your undefeated 
legend starts here--!" "We love you! 
You're the best--!!"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text: "...Heheh."

In an instant,
the girl made the field her 
own. Will victory belong to her as well?

The one to fulfill that cherished wish is 
<chrname>.
The one to seize victory here is
<chrname>.

—Let us head forth to the stage that 
decides the best in the world.
